pois.name: Canyon head, off Moss Landing
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, 2.5 km offshore of Moss Landing harbour on a bearing of 260 degrees, seabed 44 m. No source gives an exact head coordinate; this point marks where the terrain trace (this session, tools/inspect_tile.py + a bilinear sampler) first shows the canyon's steep-walled incision beginning, close to shore as the sources describe.

pois.name: Upper canyon channel
pois.note: GMRT terrain, about 265 m deep and 2.85 km in a straight line from the canyon-head marker. Located by sampling the grid toward the canyon axis; this scan point does not establish the regional shelf-break position.

pois.name: North canyon wall
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain: 748 m deep, about 700 m (and 270 m of relief) north of the axis-1000m POI at the same longitude, on the canyon's steep north wall. No specific coordinate is published for a 'wall'; this point was located by sampling terrain perpendicular to the traced axis.

pois.name: MARS cabled observatory node
pois.note: Published position 36 deg 42.7481'N, 122 deg 11.2139'W, depth 891 m (MBARI). GMRT seabed here is 888 m, within 3 m of the published depth. The real trawl-resistant frame (about 3.7 x 4.6 m at the base, 1.2 m tall) is not modelled in detail; the placed prop is a simplified marker.
